verdict.rationale: Polar develops its platform in the open at github.com/polarsource/polar under Apache-2.0, and its llms.txt (confirmed by an HTTP probe) describes it as "Open Source & Global Merchant of Record." Missing for 10: an independent or hands-on check of the repository's license file, and confirmation of whether every component is covered by the same license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
